tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gza' bdud kyi rlung gi 'khor lo'i las byang bzhugs so//

dpal dregs pa'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo// gza' bdud kyi rlung gi 'khor lo bsgrub pa'i mdun bskyed ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du/ 'khor lo dang gtor ma skad cig gis 'byung ba tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ sprin nag gi gur khang mun pa ltar 'khrigs pa'i klong du/ 'brug dang glog dang thog dang ser ba bu yug ltar 'tshub cing*/ tshig sgra dang 'ur sgra/ thug chom kyi sgra skad drag po mi bzod pa sgrog pa'i dbus su/ dgra bo mi nor yul zhing mkhar khang dang bcas pa'i steng du dregs pa ru tra pho mo'i gdan la/ skad cig gis 'byung lnga 'dus pa'i gza' mchog he ru ka khrag mig /sku mdog dmar nag glog gi ral pa gyen du 'khyug pa/ shin tu khro rngam dpa' gtum dang ldan pa/ spyan nas me stag 'phro shing*/ snyan nas 'brug sgra sgrog pa/ shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa dgra bo'i ro stod glo snying dang bcas pa bsgrad cing gsol ba/ phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub kyis cho 'phrul sna dgu dgra la 'gyed cing*/ phyag g.yon pa yum la 'khril tshul gyis dgra bo'i yan lag brgyangs pa/ sku las gza' mda' me'i tsha tsha dmar po skar ltar 'khrugs pa/ chibs su dug sbrul nag po mgo dgu la chibs nas dmigs pa'i dgra bo gsod gcod kyi las la brtson pa/ de'i pang du yum bdud mo khrag mig ma sku las bdud kyi ming rkun 'bum phrag 'phro ba/ dbu skra dmar nag 'tshub ma ltar 'khyil zhing*/ spyan nas khrag gi mchi ma srid gsum kun la 'thor ba/ shangs nas nad kyi dud pa sngo dmar 'thul ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pas dgra bo'i ro smad nang khrol dang bcas pa 'grad cing gsol ba/ phyag g.yas yab la 'khyud tshul gyis dgra bo'i yan lag brgyangs shing*/ g.yon pas yab la 'khyud nas dgra bo gsod gcod kyi las la brtson pa/ dmigs pa'i dgra bo'i gzugs liṅga dang ming yi ger btab pa rnams la thog ser nad mtshon gza' nad sna dgu char ltar 'bebs pa'i bdag nyid can/

yab yum de gnyis la 'khor snang srid dregs pa'i lha klu gza' skar sa bdag sde brgyad 'byung po'i dmag tshogs stong gsum gang bas bskor bar gyur/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dzaḥyig gis mtshan pa dpag tu med pa spros pas srin yul laṅka pu ri la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i dkyil yangs srid pa gsum na rgyu ba'i gza' bdud yab yum 'khor dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bu yug 'tshub pa ltar skad cig la bkug nas 'khor lo'i lha dang bsgoms pa'i gzugs la rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa ltar sib sib thim par gyur par bsam/ hūm̐ */ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// 'byung ba tsha grang 'khrugs 'thab gur khang nas// thog ser 'brug glog 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas// cho 'khrul nad mtshon bdag po rā hu la// gza' nad che dgu dgra la dbab pa'i phyir// drag po'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren da tshur byon// e hri ke ta ke ta ra tri nag po rā hu la badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ |zhes spyan drangs/ hūm̐ */ me rlung sprin dang thog ser 'khrugs pa'i dbus// dregs pa'i dgra bgegs ru tra bsnol ba'i steng*// sngags 'chang drag po'i phrin las bsgrub slad du// gdug byed tsakra'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ */rā hu la tsakra maṇ+ḍal tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ */zhes bzhugs su gsol/ hūm̐ */ dregs pa 'dul mdzad khro rnams kyis// gdug pa khyod rnams rab gzir tshe// dregs pa spangs nas srog snying phul/ /sngags 'chang dgra lhar khas blangs nas/ /dam tshig rdo rje mgor bzhag cing*// mna' chad bdud rtsi khar btung ba'i// dam tshig dran gyis khyod ma 'da'| |bdag gi las 'di myur sgrubs shig /rā hu la sa ma ya na rak+kan/ zhes dam la bzhag /hūm̐ */ dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba yi// khrag gi ar+ghaṃ mtsho ltar 'khyil// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog bkram// sha chen bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs// tshil chen mar me nyi ltar gsal// khrag zhag dri chab lbu phreng g.yo// sha khrag rkang klad zhal zas brjid// dur khrod rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog

/sman raka dug can 'jings ltar gtams// gtor tshogs ri rab ltar spungs pa// khyod la zhu skyems rngan pa 'bul// bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di// myur du khug sod kha raṃ khā hi// rā hu+u la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pū dza ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad a mṛ ta ru dhī ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ zhes mchod/ gtor mar sha zan dang sman raka sgron la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod bhan+dha rlon pa skra'i ba dan/ stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du nṛ las dgra bo bsgral ba'i sha khrag klad rus dbang po nang khrol rtsa rgyus khu ba chu ser phung khams skye mched sman raka bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dod yon gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la rā tri nag po ra skyes chen po sa pa ri wā ra sha trūṃ a mu kaṃ maṃ sa rak+ta keṃ ni ri ti tsit+ta ba su ta go ro tsa na pañca skan+dha.a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling+ta i maṃ kha kha khā hi kha hi/ zhes nyer gcig gam bdun gyis phul la/ gtor ma dgra bgegs sha khrag dbang po don snod phung khams skye mched nang rol sman raka 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ gza' mchog chen po he ru ka khrag mig /yab yum bdud mo khrag mig ma 'khor snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la 'bul lo// bzhes shig /rol cig /kha raṃ khā hi/ las la mthu ma chung bar tshim zhing rang ba dang dgyes par bzhes la/ mi nga la lha med zer ba/ lha khyod la mthu med zer ba/ mthu bu lon bzhin du rnyog par byed pa'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bo ming yi ge gzugs liṅga drag po'i 'khor lor btab pa 'di me tshe ring po la dus ma 'debs/ nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzug /skye 'chi gnyis la khung ma g.yar/ las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa la snyad ma 'dogs/ lo dang zla bar ma 'gyang*/

zhag dang za mar ma 'gor bar da lta nyid du khug cig /ma shor zhig /ma gtong zhig /ming dang ming ma nor/ bla dang bla ma nor| rus dang rus ma nor bar dgra 'di la than dang ltas ngan thog ser dme 'khrug nad mtshon dal yams grib than gza' nad rnam pa sna tshogs pa char ltar phob la sod cig /bsad rtags don snying mgo dang don snying dmar po da lta nyid du khyer la shog cig sa ma ya hoḥ zhes 'dod don gsol/ e/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// sman raka bdud rtsi'i mchod pa la// sbyor sgrol gtor ma'i mchod pa dang*// dgra bo bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// rkang klad khu ba zhag chu ser// don snying phung khams skye mched dang*// mi nor yul zhing mkhar khang sogs// dgra bo'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs bcas// tshe srog lus dbang rlung rta dang*// klad bug rnam shes ma lus pa// gza' bdud thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul// lhag ma med par zhal du 'bul| |dgyes par rol la thugs dam bskang*// bskangs gyur thugs dang 'gal ba bshags// tshangs par mdzod la dgra bo sgrol// ces thugs dam bskangs/ e/ dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad gza' mchog rā hu la// gdug pa'i bzhin can bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// khrag gi spyan dmar dgra bo'i dus mthar gzigs// sku las bdud kyi bla rkun 'bum phrag 'phro/ */ gsung gi nga ros gza' nad thog ltar 'bebs// thugs kyi sprul pas cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'gyed// dug sbrul mgo dgu 'bar ba zhon pa'i 'gros// glog ltar mgyogs pas stong gsum yud kyis skor// khros pas gza' nad che dgu dgra la 'bebs// yum chen khrag mig dgyes sde chung mar 'khril// mthu chen dregs pa yongs kyi dmag dpon mdzod// ra skyes khrag mig gdug pa'i mtshan 'chang ba// dbang phyug gza' bdud yab yum 'khor dang bcas// sngags 'chang dgra blar mnga' gsol bstod par bgyi// dam rdzas 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams da bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las drag po myur sgrubs shig

/ces bstod/ 'khor lo sgrub pa'i ring 'di yan nangs re tshar re byed/ skabs 'dir 'bod rbad bsad gsum gyi dmigs pa logs su yod pa ltar gsal bas sngags rnams nyin mtshan so sor phye la bzla'o// thun drug tu dbye dgug gi sngon du bskul byang bya ba ni/ thun gtor 'khor liṅga dgug gzhug gi sngon du gtor bsngos gong ltar byas mthar/ /kyai/ 'byung bzhi tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i zhing khams nas// sprin tshogs gur gang nag po'i pho brang nas// thog ser nad mtshon 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas// cho 'phrul sna dgu 'bar ba'i mkhar nang nas// dregs pa ru tra bsnol ba'i gdan steng na// gza' mchog chen po he ru ka khrag mig /sku mdog dmar nag glog gi zhags pa can// chibs su dug sbrul 'bar ba mgo dgu chibs// phyag gis chu srin gdug pa ngan dgu gtong*// sku las bdud kyi ming rkun 'bum 'phro 'khrigs// shin tu mi zad khro rngam dpa' gtum can// khrag gi spyan mig dam nyams dgra la gzigs// sku ni nan tar khros shing skyod pa'i tshe// gza' nad che dgu dgra la gtong bar byed// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// gza' nad drag pos dgra bo'i lus sems 'bral// thugs kyi cho 'phrul las la 'gyed pa'i tshe// dgra la ltas ngan sna tshogs char du 'bebs// de 'dra'i gza' bdud ra skyes khrag gi mig /khyod la zhu skyems gnyan po 'bul ba ni/ rin chen gser skyems sman raka sha khrag rus// dam rdzas dmar gyi gtor ma gsol zhing mchod// sngon gyi bka' dang dam la tshul bzhin du// sngags 'chang bdag gi gzu dang dpang btsugs gis// bka' la mi nyan dam la mi gnas pa'i// dgra bo'i ming rus bris pa 'di dag gi// phyi yi yul du thog ser skyin thang phob// nang gi 'byung bzhi'i lus las rnam shes phrol// srog chod dbugs longs 'go ba'i lha dang phrol// mtshon dbal nad kyis lus sems 'khrugs su chug

/skyi sdang hur thum sdang ba'i dgra la phob// dal yams rims nad sdang ba'i dgra la phob// mi rung ltas ngan sdang ba'i dgra la phob// dme 'thab 'byed dkrug sdang ba'i dgra la phob// sad ser thog 'khyug sdang ba'i dgra la phob// dug mtshon mu ge sdang ba'i dgra la phob// glo bur ye 'brog sdang ba'i dgra la phob// mi bzad cho 'phrul sdang ba'i dgra la phob// gza' nad che dgu sdang ba'i dgra la phob// ma g.yel ma 'da' gza' bdud dgra la rgyugs// dam las ma 'da' dgra srog myur du chod// bdud mo 'bum gyi za kha dgra la ston// nam phyed dgra bo'i tshe srog rtsad nas chod// bsad rtags mgo dang srog snying khyer la shog /ma 'da' dam skong bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs/ /zhes drag tu bskul zhing rbad do/ /las byang 'di'i mngon rtogs dang bskul byang ni 'phel mo blo gros 'bum pa rang gis mdzad pa yin la| spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i bar gyi rung mthun du 'bri gung pa dus mtha'i sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas sbyar ba ste/ 'di ni snying po'i bstan pa srung ba dang yid la brnag pa'i phyi nang gi dgra rnams kyi srog gi gshed mar smon lam btab nas bris so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
